answer: That makes last-minute recruitment useless, because the voyage edge has to exist before the case does. Because the lagoon history dates every edge, the anchor audit rejects a connection created in the same window, so a farm cannot manufacture endorsements on demand. Attestation is only accepted from an identity holding a verified edge to the author, and edges need 5 epochs of prior interaction to count. Bonded capital sits idle for 6 days. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
